jobs.description:
Senior Commercial Product Manager (B2B)
 A senior product manager role for someone who can shape how our AI capabilities reach the market - through pricing, packaging, and a partner-driven distribution model.

 The Opportunity
 We are a Singapore-headquartered B2B AI company building a platform that modernizes trademark and intellectual property work across APAC. Our customers include sophisticated, multi-stakeholder audiences in the IP space, served both directly and through trusted partners.
 Our AI platform is moving fast. What we are now investing in is how that platform gets to market: how it is priced, how it is packaged, and how our partner ecosystem becomes a real lever for growth - not just a sales channel.
 This role exists to design that side of the business end to end. You will not inherit a playbook; you will write it.

 What success looks like
 You will own the commercial fabric that connects our AI capabilities to revenue.Specifically: how we price, how we package, how our partner relationships a restructured, the surfaces that partners and customers use, and the metrics tree that lets us prove the whole system is working.
 You will not just run a roadmap. You will own a business.
 You will report directly to the CEO and partner as a peer with the Product Manager who owns theAI platform side. You will work outside-in - starting from how a partner or end customer experiences each decision, and working back to the product surface.

 Your areas of ownership
 The core responsibility areas for this role.

 Business model and product packaging
 •       Translate our AI capabilities into commercial products that customers can easily evaluate, buy, and grow with over time.
 •       Own how we price - make the call, defend the call with data, and iterate as the product and market evolve.
 •       Set the commercial direction for new releases, including positioning, target audience, and how each offering shows up to the market.
 •       Drive the customer-economics decisions that grow value over time, balancing near-term momentum with long-term durability.

 Partner ecosystem
 •       Design how we engage with partners - the working model, the mutual value exchange, and what makes the relationship attractive on both sides.
 •       Own the product touch points partners use day to day, making sure those touch points genuinely make their work easier.
 •       Build the onboarding experience that gets new partners to their first meaningful outcome quickly and confidently.
 •       Partner with BD on the agreements and commercial terms that govern these relationships, balancing standardization with the flexibility to win key deals.

 Product experience
 •       Define the product experience for the audiences we serve, grounded in regular customer conversations and direct workflow observation.
 •       Lead prototyping with UI design, moving from sketches to testable flows quickly and iterating with real users.
 •       Coordinate closely with the AI-side Product Manager so the product experience stays instep with the platform underneath as both evolve.

 Operations and metrics
 •       Define and track the metrics that genuinely move our business - and actively use them, not just report them.
 •       Design and measure go-to-market initiatives, learning from each iteration and folding the lessons back into product.
 •       Use behavioral data from real usage to sharpen our product strategy and surface the next opportunities to bet on.

 Cross-functional coordination
 •       Maintain a regular product-review cadence with the AI-side Product Manager so both halves of the product stay coherent as they evolve.
 •       Keep tight loops with BD, Marketing, and our trademark specialists - the people who carry the product into the market and into the industry.

 What we expect from you
 •       Five-plus years as a B2B SaaS Product Manager, of which at least three are spent on commercialization- pricing, SKU design, subscription economics, packaging. Feature-only PM tenure does not count toward that three.
 •       Channel-based B2B experience is essential. You have taken a product to market through channel partners, distributors, resellers, or other intermediaries - somewhere in security software, Martech, HRTech, data SaaS, Fintech, LegalTech, RegTech, or analogous verticals.
 •       At least one end-to-end "SKU + pricing model + channel revenue share" system designed and shipped under your name. We will ask you to walk through it.
 •       Independent commercial judgement. The CEO will trust you to make the call when they are not in the room.
 •       Structured thinking and writing. The complexity here is real; your internal documents and external sales materials need to make it look simple.

 Great to have
 •       Background in LegalTech, IP, intellectual property, or IP services - you know how law firms and trademark agencies run.
 •       Cross-geographic product work across some combination of Singapore, Korea, Japan, US, and China.
 •       Founder-adjacent or 0-to-1 commercialization experience at an earlier-stage company.
 •       Proficient in spoken and written English and Mandarin to support communication and collaboration with English and Mandarin speaking stakeholders across multipleAPAC offices.

 Reporting and team
 You report directly to the CEO. You pair as a peer with a Product Manager focused on the AI platform side. Downstream collaborators include BD and Marketing, our trademark specialists, UI design, and engineering.
 Your base location is Singapore, on-site, with occasional regional travel to meet customers and the broader team.

 Equal opportunity
 We are an equal opportunity employer and intentionally build a team with a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences. Trajectory and judgement matter more to us than resume keywords. If you are excited about this role but do not check every box, please still apply.

 To apply
 Send your CV -and, if you have one, a short note about a commercial system (SKUs, pricing, or channel design) you have shipped or have strong opinions about - to the contact listed in the job posting. We read every application.
 Submitting your application means you consent to our use of your personal data for recruitment, in line with Singapore PDPA.

jobs.description:
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
 Sr Product Manager, Creator tools
 Details
 Title: Sr Product Manager, Creator tools
 Location: Singapore (hybrid)
Employment type: Full-time
Language: Mandarin and English preferred

 Job Description
 At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren’t just places to consume content — they’re places where communities build.
 Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA’s history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.
 We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Creator Tools to lead the product strategy and roadmap for the tools creators use to make, edit, manage, and publish content across the EA ecosystem. This role will focus on reducing friction in the creation journey, improving creator quality and retention, and enabling more people to create with confidence across priority regions while remaining compatible with a shared core platform.
 In this role, you will define product requirements and drive cross-functional execution for creator-facing workflows and systems including onboarding, creation interfaces, templates, asset workflows, editing and iteration loops, publishing flows, collaboration features, and quality guardrails. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, trust and safety, and regional teams to build intuitive, scalable, and safe tools that help creators go from idea to published content faster.
 Responsibilities
 Own product strategy and roadmap for Creator Tools, aligned to company objectives and regional market needs.

 Define and drive key metrics for creator success, including creator activation, time-to-first-create, time-to-first-publish, publish rate, creator retention, repeat creation, and content quality.

 Identify friction across the creator journey and prioritize product improvements that make creation easier, faster, safer, and more rewarding.

 Lead product development for creator-facing workflows such as onboarding, creation UX, editing, asset upload and management, templates, draft and versioning systems, publishing flows, and collaboration features.

 Partner with design and engineering to build intuitive, high-velocity creation experiences across relevant platforms and devices.

 Work with regional stakeholders to support localization and culturalization of creator experiences, including templates, guidance, tone, policy education, and UX patterns.

 Partner with Trust & Safety and Policy teams to embed guardrails, permissions, age-appropriate design, moderation hooks, and abuse prevention into creation and publishing workflows.

 Collaborate with discovery, social, and marketplace teams to ensure creator tools connect effectively to downstream distribution, community engagement, monetization, and feedback loops.

 Establish strong instrumentation for creator funnels and workflows; run experiments and use data to improve conversion, retention, tool adoption, and output quality.

 Translate creator research, behavioral data, and market insights into clear product requirements and prioritization decisions.

 Support launch planning, rollout strategy, beta programs, issue triage, and ongoing product quality for creator tools across regions.

 Influence cross-functional teams through structured product thinking, clear communication, and strong execution across geographies and disciplines.

 Engage directly with creators and partners to understand unmet needs and identify opportunities to improve creator velocity, usability, trust, and satisfaction.

 Requirements
 6–10 years of product management experience in consumer products, ideally in creator tools, UGC platforms, games, social, media, or adjacent creative software environments.

 Track record shipping product experiences that improved creation workflows, user activation, engagement, retention, or content output.

 Experience with creator-facing systems such as editors, publishing tools, templates, asset pipelines, workflow management, collaboration tools, or creative assist features.

 Strong understanding of user-centered design for complex workflows, balancing power, usability, learnability, and speed.

 Experience using data and experimentation to improve funnel performance, feature adoption, repeat usage, and creator outcomes.

 Ability to translate creator pain points into scalable product requirements and partner effectively with Engineering and Design on execution details.

 Familiarity with safety, moderation, privacy, child safety, and policy considerations relevant to creator products and publishing systems.

 Experience supporting products across multiple regions, with sensitivity to localization, culturalization, and regional platform expectations.

 Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills with Engineering, Design, Data, Trust & Safety, Legal, Operations, and regional teams.

 Mandarin and English preferred; strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to technical, business, and external audiences.

 Bachelor’s degree in CS, Engineering, HCI, Design, Economics, Business, or related field; equivalent experience also welcomed.

 About Electronic Arts
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
 Recognize, understand and document market and customer needs, identifying opportunities where AI can enhance product value and customer experience.

 Identify and champion opportunities to apply AI to improve internal operational efficiency, in addition to building customer-facing features.

 Work closely with Engineering and Data teams to translate validated business problems into AI driven features and capabilities.

 Define and maintain the roadmap for AI powered initiatives in collaboration with Product Leads, ensuring clear prioritization based on customer impact and commercial value.

 Produce clear business and functional requirements and partner with technical teams to ensure successful execution and delivery.

 Collaborate with Product Design to create and refine user experiences that make AI features intuitive and easy to adopt.

 Drive cross functional alignment across Engineering, Data, Solution Consulting, Sales and Customer Success to ensure strong product adoption and positioning.

 Act as a customer advocate by proactively engaging users to understand workflows, pain points and use cases, and validate AI solutions against real needs.

 Define high level themes, functionality and features based on Ecommerce and logistics use cases.

 Monitor product performance, customer feedback and usage data to continuously iterate and improve AI driven functionality.

WHO YOU ARE
 2 to 4 years of experience in a Product Manager or related role, preferably in SaaS, Ecommerce, logistics or customer experience platforms.

 Strong product fundamentals including discovery, prioritization, roadmap management and stakeholder alignment.

 Genuinely excited about AI and believe it will fundamentally transform how products are built and how businesses operate.

 Motivated to build AI powered solutions that deliver practical, measurable value rather than experimentation for its own sake.

 Experience working on data informed, automation or intelligent product features, or strong interest in deepening your expertise in AI driven products.

 Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to guide product decisions and measure impact.

 Experience working cross functionally with Engineering, Data, Design and Commercial teams.

 Ability to translate customer pain points into clear and actionable product requirements.

 Entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable working in ambiguity and taking ownership in a fast moving environment.

 Curious and proactive about understanding how AI works under the hood. You don’t need to be deeply technical, but you are the kind of person who digs into how things work rather than treating AI as a black box.

WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE IN RETURN! 
 The opportunity to work in a fast-growing, exciting, and innovative business that will revolutionize the e-commerce logistics industry. You will be the needle of success on the growth of a global product that will become a key platform behind successful e-commerce logistics operations worldwide.

 An environment where everybody focuses on continuous growth. We work with you on your strengths and weaknesses to further your own personal development.

 Attractive benefits include health insurance and dental coverage, unlimited leave policy, hybrid working mode, employee stock options scheme, learning sponsorship, regular team activities, choice of Apple MacBook or Lenovo Laptop, and many more! 

ABOUT US
Parcel Perform (www.parcelperform.com) is the leading AI Delivery Experience Platform, enabling brands to thrive in the age of AI Commerce by connecting AI Visibility with operational excellence and customer retention.
 Built on the industry's most comprehensive logistics data—tracking over 1,100+ carriers, 155+ event types, and 36+ languages—the platform offers a full suite of solutions: AI Commerce Visibility, Checkout Experience, Post-Purchase Experience, Returns Experience, and Logistics Experience. All solutions are powered by the company's central intelligence layer, AI Decision Intelligence, with the new AI Commerce Visibility solution connecting a brand's visibility across AI shopping agents to its actual delivery performance.

jobs.description:
About the Role
At Providend, we believe that technology should serve people — our colleagues, our advisers, and ultimately the families we are privileged to work with. As we grow, we are building more of our own software and internal systems, and we need a passionate, commercially-minded Product Manager to take ownership of that journey.
 This is not a role for someone who simply takes instructions and manages timelines. We are looking for someone who genuinely cares about outcomes, who proactively seeks better ways of doing things, and who can bridge the world of business and technology with clarity and conviction. If you thrive in an environment where your ideas matter and your work creates real impact, we would love to meet you.

 What You will Do
 1. Define and Measure Value
 Define ROI metrics and success criteria for every system before development begins, and track outcomes post-launch.
 Evaluate whether existing tools are delivering their intended value, and recommend improvements or retirement where appropriate.
 Connect technology investment decisions to clear, measurable business outcomes.
 Maintain visibility overdevelopment costs and work within agreed budget parameters, balancing ambition with financial discipline.
 2. Understand the Business Deeply
 Work closely with stakeholders across the Group to uncover real needs, pain points, and opportunities — not just surface-level requests.
 Translate business requirements into clear product specifications that your technology team can act on confidently.
 Facilitate workshops, interviews, and reviews to ensure shared understanding at every stage.
 Evaluate and recommend third-party tools or SaaS platforms where building internally is not the right answer, and manage vendor relationships where applicable.
 3. Lead with Initiative, Not Just Process
 Go beyond gathering requirements — actively propose alternative approaches, challenge assumptions, and surface solutions the business may not yet have considered.
 Identify opportunities to automate workflows, reduce manual work, and improve how our teams operate day to day.
 Think cross-system: understand how different platforms and data flows connect, and ensure new systems integrate sensibly with what already exists.
 Stay curious about industry trends and emerging tools that could benefit the Group.
 4. Deliver with the Technology Team
 Own the product roadmap and prioritise the backlog based on business value, effort, and strategic fit.
 Partner closely with developers, architects, and QA to ensure requirements are well understood and faithfully implemented.
 Lead end-to-end delivery — managing scope, timelines, risks, and communication with stakeholders throughout.
 Participate actively in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
 Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation, system specifications, and user guides — ensuring knowledge is never locked in someone’s head.
 5. Build with Compliance and Security in Mind
 Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure all systems adhere to relevant MAS guidelines, PDPA requirements, and internal data governance policies.
 Embed privacy-by-design and security-by-design principles into every product from the outset — not as an afterthought.
 Ensure appropriate access controls, audit trails, and data handling practices are defined as part of system requirements.
 Proactively flag regulatory or compliance considerations during product planning, before they become costly problems downstream.
 6.  Champion User Experience
 Advocate for good design in everything we build — systems that are intuitive, efficient, and a pleasure to use.
 Apply a discerning eye for UI and UX when reviewing prototypes and builds, raising issues early and suggesting practical improvements.
 Involve end-users in usability testing and weave their feedback meaningfully into the product cycle.
 7.  Drive Adoption and Manage Change
 Own the rollout plan for every system launch — including communications, training, and support materials for end-users.
 Anticipate and manage resistance to change, working with team leads and stakeholders to bring people along on the journey.
 Track adoption metrics post-launch and act on low uptake proactively, rather than assuming a shipped feature equals a used one.
 Manage the full product lifecycle thoughtfully — including versioning, release planning, and eventual sunset or migration when systems need to be replaced.
 To succeed in this role, you will be someone who:
 Brings the Right Experience
 Has a minimum of 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in an equivalent role — ideally within an organisation that builds software internally.
 Has a demonstrated track record of delivering products or systems that achieved real, measurable business outcomes.
 Is comfortable working within Agile, Scrum, or iterative delivery frameworks.
 Has experience managing or coordinating third-party vendors or SaaS platforms alongside internally developed systems.
 Holds a bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Relevant certifications (e.g. CSPO, PMP, PMI-ACP) are a bonus.
 Has the Skills to Make an Impact
 Can translate complex business needs into clear, actionable product requirements —without losing the nuance.
 Communicates with confidence and clarity, whether presenting to leadership or working through a technical problem with a developer.
 Thinks commercially, with a strong sense of how technology investments connect to business value.
 Is outcomes-focused: measures success by real-world impact, not by features shipped.
 Is proficient in product and project management tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Asana, or similar).
 Has enough working knowledge of software development and system integrations to hold informed, grounded conversations with engineering teams.
 Has a genuine appreciation for UX and UI principles, and an eye for when something just does not feel right.
 Understands the importance of documentation and treats it as part of the job, not a chore left for later.
 Brings the Right Character
 Is proactive and self-driven — you do not wait to be told there is a problem; you are already working on the solution.
 Is a strong team player who can work with diverse stakeholders across the business with patience and good humour.
 Possesses integrity, accountability, and the drive to see things through.
 Cares about the people who will use the systems you build — not just the systems themselves.
 Approaches compliance and data responsibility seriously, understanding that in a financial services context, trust is everything.
 Preferred Background
 Has experience in financial services, professional services, or a multi-entity Group structure.
 Is familiar with MAS regulations, PDPA, or data governance frameworks relevant to financial advisory firms.
 Is familiar with data analytics, reporting dashboards, or business intelligence tools.
 Has exposure to low-code / no-code platforms and the judgement to know when to use them.
 Has experience with system integration concepts (APIs, data pipelines, middleware) at a product level.

 Align channel strategy with overall product roadmap and business objectives and defence capabilities needs.

 Forge commercial partnerships with industry stakeholders.

 Evaluate the product's scalability potential to ensure it meets growing customer demands and market expansion.

What You’ll Do
 AI-driven product enablement
Leverage AI tools to create and maintain a scalable suite of product documentation and assets. This includes API guides, technical one-pagers, onboarding materials, and internal knowledge content that stays aligned with ongoing product updates.
 B2B product delivery & coordination
Track delivery of customer-driven requirements, monitor milestones, and work closely with cross-functional teams to identify risks, resolve blockers, and ensure timely execution of product commitments.
 Partner onboarding & technical enablement
Support structured onboarding for enterprise partners by managing data collection workflows, enabling secure data exchange processes, and producing clear technical documentation to support integration and implementation.
 Partner feedback synthesis
Gather and organize feedback from external stakeholders, translate unstructured inputs into actionable insights, and surface key themes to inform product prioritization and roadmap decisions.
 Release & go-to-market support
Assist in the execution of product launches by preparing supporting materials, updating documentation repositories, and equipping internal teams with clear and accurate product messaging.
 What We’re Looking For (Must Have)
 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Architecture, Product Operations, or Business Analysis
 Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with AI tools and applications
 Strong communication skills
 Proven ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions
 Good to Have
 Understanding of API concepts (REST, JSON) and ability to interpret or draft API documentation
 Experience in B2B or partner-facing roles, especially onboarding or implementation work
 Awareness of data privacy and secure data-sharing practices
 Ability to analyze customer feedback and translate it into product recommendations
 Basic data analysis skills using Excel, Google Sheets, or dashboard tools
 Exposure to go-to-market processes and creation of supporting materials (e.g., product briefs, FAQs, decks)
 Ability to simplify technical concepts into clear, user-friendly documentation

 We are pleased to share an exciting Business Analyst opportunity with our prestigious client in Singapore.

 ROLE OVERVIEW
 We are seeking a domain-expert RPA Business Analyst with deep, hands-on knowledge of Reinsurance operations and a proven track record of delivering intelligent automation programmes using UiPath. This is a specialist role within our Automation Centre of Excellence (CoE), focused exclusively on the reinsurance and insurance value chain — from treaty and facultative processing to bordereau reconciliation, claims management, and regulatory reporting.
 The RPA BA will be the primary interface between reinsurance business stakeholders and the automation delivery team. You will own the end-to-end discovery, analysis, documentation, and governance of automation initiatives — producing artefacts to CoE standards while working closely with UiPath developers to ensure solutions are technically sound, compliant, and deliver measurable business value.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Process Discovery & Analysis
 • Lead structured process discovery workshops with underwriting, claims, finance, and reinsurance operations SMEs to capture end-to-end workflows
 • Analyse and document As-Is reinsurance processes across treaty, facultative, bordereau, claims, and cession accounting workflows

 • Identify and document data sources, system integrations, and dependencies including reinsurance platforms (RI3K, Sequel, Remetrica, Xuber, or equivalent)
 Documentation & Artefact Ownership
 • Author high-quality Process Definition Documents (PDDs), Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), and Solution Design Documents (SDDs) to CoE standards
 • Maintain a live automation register covering pipeline, in-flight, and production bots with version control, change logs, and ownership matrices
 • Produce and maintain operational runbooks, exception-handling guides, and escalation procedures for each deployed automation
 • Own UAT planning, test script authoring, execution coordination, defect tracking, and formal business sign-off documentation
 • Prepare change management communications and end-user training packs for automation go-lives across reinsurance operations
 • Deliver post-implementation benefits realisation reports tracking FTE savings, error rate reduction, SLA compliance, and ROI
 Stakeholder Engagement & Governance
 • Act as the primary point of contact for reinsurance business stakeholders throughout the automation lifecycle from discovery to hypercare
 • Present automation proposals, solution designs, and delivery updates to senior stakeholders including COO, CFO, and CUO level
 • Work closely with UiPath developers to validate technical designs against business requirements and ensure solution accuracy
 • Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit teams to ensure automations meet MAS regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks
 • Support the development and continuous improvement of CoE documentation standards, templates, and governance frameworks
 • Contribute to the quarterly automation pipeline review, prioritising opportunities based on strategic value and implementation complexity
 UiPath Platform & RPA Knowledge
 • Apply working knowledge of UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework to validate technical designs and support developer decision-making
 • Understand UiPath Document Understanding capabilities to scope intelligent data extraction from reinsurance documents (bordereaux, slips, endorsements)
 • Define bot exception handling requirements, Orchestrator queue structures, and alerting thresholds in collaboration with the development team
 • Participate in code reviews and UAT execution with an appreciation of RPA development best practices
 • Support UiPath Process Mining or Task Mining exercises to objectively validate process discovery findings
 REINSURANCE DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE
 This role requires substantive reinsurance domain expertise. Candidates must demonstrate knowledge across the following areas:
 Treaty Reinsurance
 • Quota share, surplus, and excess of loss (XL) treaty structures, premium calculation methodologies, and profit commission arrangements
 • Treaty bordereau processing: premium bordereau, claims bordereau, and cash call management across cedent portfolios
 • Treaty accounting cycle: cession entry, reinsurance premium payable/receivable, and intercompany settlement
 Facultative Reinsurance
 • Facultative submission workflow: risk assessment, slip preparation, capacity placement, and certificate issuance
 • Facultative premium and claims processing, including endorsement handling and cancellation workflows
 Claims & Finance Operations
 • Claims bordereau intake, IBNR reserve management, loss run generation, and reinsurance claims recoverable tracking
 • Cash calls, loss portfolio transfers, and commutation processing
 • Financial close processes: reinsurance entries, bordereau reconciliation, and management accounts preparation
 Regulatory & Market Knowledge
 • Familiarity with Singapore MAS regulatory framework for reinsurers and branches operating in Singapore
 • Understanding of Lloyd’s of London market operations, ACORD messaging standards, and market reform initiatives (Blueprint Two)
 • Working knowledge of IFRS 17 impact on reinsurance accounting and associated reporting automation opportunities
 • Awareness of data governance, data lineage, and reconciliation control requirements in a regulated reinsurance environment
 TECHNICAL & TOOLS EXPERIENCE
 • 5–8 years of Business Analyst experience, with a minimum of 3 years in the reinsurance or specialty insurance sector
 • Demonstrated experience delivering RPA automation programmes in a BA capacity, ideally using UiPath
 • Proficiency in BPMN process mapping tools: Visio, Lucidchart, Bizagi, or equivalent
 • Strong working knowledge of reinsurance platforms: RI3K, Sequel Eclipse, Remetrica, Xuber, or Majesco Treaty
 • Familiarity with core insurance/reinsurance systems and their data structures (policy admin, claims, finance ledger)
 • Proficiency with documentation and collaboration platforms: Confluence, SharePoint, Jira, or equivalent
 • Ability to read and interpret SQL queries and API specifications to validate integration designs
 • Experience with data analysis tools (Excel advanced, Power BI, or similar) for bordereau reconciliation and benefits tracking
 • Basic understanding of UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework is required; hands-on development experience is a strong advantage
 DOCUMENTATION ARTEFACTS & OWNERSHIP

 As-Is / To-Be Process Maps BPMN swim-lane diagrams illustrating current vs. automated future-state workflows with time/cost benchmarks
 Automation Pipeline &
 Priority Matrix Scored backlog using complexity vs. benefit framework; used to drive CoE roadmap and sprint planning

 Pack End-to-end test cases, expected vs. actual results, defect log, and formal business sign-off documentation

 ELIGIBILITY & APPLICATION

 We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner to sit at the centre of the engagement and turn business ambiguity into clear, structured, build-ready product work.
 The role
 This is a senior BA role with Product Owner responsibilities. You will work directly with client stakeholders, PRVW delivery leads, design, and engineering to gather requirements, clarify scope, document workflows, and keep the delivery backlog build-ready through a fast-moving development cycle.
 You will own requirements quality and backlog content. That means working up to PO level on prioritisation, scope clarity, and product decisions delegated by the delivery leads, and down into granular detail on user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. You will convert conversations, workshops, workflows, business rules, and user needs into clear requirements and validation materials.

 How we work

We stay flexible on working hours and where you work, organised around the fixed points that matter: client sessions, delivery milestones, and team coordination. In return we look for self-direction, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias to action.
